hints.tr: Önce sınıflar (2xx, 3xx), sonra tek tek kodlar (`code in (401, 403)`, `code == 404`, `code == 429`), en sonda genel 4xx ve 5xx.
hints.en: First the classes (2xx, 3xx), then the individual codes (`code in (401, 403)`, `code == 404`, `code == 429`), and the general 4xx and 5xx last.

checks.expected:
200 -> use the body
201 -> use the body
301 -> follow Location
401 -> check your key
403 -> check your key
404 -> check the address
422 -> fix the request
429 -> wait, then retry
500 -> retry later
503 -> retry later
